name: shueho-commerce-pilot · ChatGPT-like 电商 Agent 网页设计规范
description: 面向电商 agent 网页应用的前端技术架构、UI 套件、视觉风格、组件契约和开发规范。视觉方向参考 ChatGPT 网页端的克制工作台风格，但不复制品牌资产。

frontendArchitecture.styling: Tailwind CSS v4 + CSS custom properties
frontendArchitecture.streaming: native EventSource + typed hooks for backend SSE
frontendArchitecture.localUiState: Zustand only for non-authoritative UI state

constraints: Web application only; no Electron/Tauri/native desktop shell as product surface
Frontend must call the app backend/gateway, never Codex App Server directly
Codex provider secrets and commerce system tokens stay server-side
shadcn/ui + Radix + Tailwind tokens is the primary UI system
No Ant Design/MUI/Bootstrap/Mantine as primary UI kit without explicit user approval
No ChatGPT/OpenAI trademark, logo, or proprietary asset copying
No decorative gradients, gradient orbs, nested cards, marketing hero first screen, or green composer input focus rectangle
All frontend changes must conform to DESIGN.md and references before implementation
